shortDescription: Activates or deactivates the filter rules.

options.name: action
options.description: Specifies the action to perform. C(add) to add filter rules. C(check) to check the syntax of filter rules. C(change) to change filter rules. C(import) to import filter rules from an export file. C(export) to export filter rules to an export file.

options.name: directory
options.description: When I(action=import) or I(action=export), specifies the directory where the text files are to be read. When I(action=export), directory will be created if it does not exist.

options.name: ipv4
options.description: Specifies the IPv4 filter module state and rules.

options.name: ipv6
options.description: Specifies the IPv6 filter module state and rules.

options.name: rawexport
options.description: When I(action=export), specifies to export filter rules as is and to not reverse direction on rules.
